question: Should the legacy `https://molt.bot/install.sh` zsh installer remain supported by this project, be redirected to current ClawHub/OpenClaw install commands, or be retired?
rationale: The failing implementation is outside current main while current docs and UI point to maintained install flows, so automation cannot safely choose the product support boundary.

options.title: Redirect or retire legacy installer
options.body: Point legacy `molt.bot` users to maintained install commands and document the supported Node range.

options.title: Support and harden installer
options.body: Bring the hosted installer source under traceable ownership and guard the unmatched zsh cleanup glob on macOS/Homebrew.

options.title: Wait for fresh reproduction
options.body: Keep this waiting until there is evidence that a currently supported install path still fails.

recommendation.title: Redirect or retire legacy installer
recommendation.body: Point legacy `molt.bot` users to maintained install commands and document the supported Node range.

likelyOwner.reason: Patrick-Erichsen owns the nearest current in-repo CLI/package install surface and the VISION.md support-boundary context.
